name: Tia Dalma's Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Rice & Peas (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Scotch bonnet / habanero jerk spice rub, allspice, lime, and whole red kidney beans in the rice make this a severe flare trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Do not order the Jerk Chicken; request the Lighter Note plain oven-roasted chicken breast with plain white rice instead.
watchOuts: Scotch bonnet chili capsaicin in jerk rub
